# Redshift

> Redshift is a sovereign secret-management tool built on Nostr. The certified v0.14.2 individual product provides a Doppler-inspired CLI with an explicit Redshift command contract; it does not claim full compatibility or drop-in behavior.

Important boundaries:

- Secret bundles are encrypted client-side with NIP-59 before publication; relays do not receive plaintext.
- The CLI authenticates with a local nsec or an NIP-46 remote signer. NIP-07 is a browser-dashboard method, not a CLI login method.
- History is bounded state observed from responding relays, not retained history, an audit log, offline recovery, or an SLA.
- Cloud, paid subscriptions, Teams, Enterprise SSO, managed retention/backup, and availability guarantees are not launched.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://redshiftapp.com/docs): supported product and security boundaries
- [Installation](https://redshiftapp.com/docs/installation): verified Linux and macOS installer
- [Quick Start](https://redshiftapp.com/docs/quickstart): authentication, project setup, secret management, and command execution

## Primary CLI Commands

- `redshift login`: authenticate interactively with local nsec or NIP-46
- `redshift login --bunker-stdin`: read a bunker URI through protected input
- `redshift login --connect`: start client-initiated NostrConnect pairing
- `redshift setup`: configure project/environment identifiers in `redshift.yaml`
- `redshift secrets`: list redacted secret names and values
- `redshift secrets set <KEY> <VALUE>`: set one secret
- `redshift secrets get <KEY>`: read a redacted value; `--raw` explicitly reveals plaintext
- `redshift secrets delete <KEY>`: publish current-state logical deletion
- `redshift run -- <command> [args...]`: execute exact argv with secrets injected and Redshift credentials scrubbed
- `redshift backup`, `redshift history`, and `redshift recovery`: user-initiated local portability and bounded relay-state workflows
- `redshift serve`: start the embedded individual dashboard

## Installation

The verified installer supports Linux and macOS on x64 and arm64 and requires GitHub CLI attestation verification:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://redshiftapp.com/install | sh
redshift --version
```

No npm, Bun, Homebrew, or Windows package is currently published.

## Configuration

`redshift setup` creates identifier-only configuration:

```yaml
project: my-app
environment: development
relays:
  - wss://relay.damus.io
```

Keep nsec values, bunker pairing secrets, passphrases, raw secret output, and provider credentials out of configuration, argv, logs, and captured terminals.
